map.100m 干货船静水力示例: Hydrostatic example for a 100 m general cargo vessel
map.MTC 和 TPC 有什么区别？: What is the difference between MTC and TPC?
map.TPC 为每增加 1cm 吃水对应的排水量变化(t/cm)，MTC 为产生 1c: TPC is the change in displacement per 1 cm of additional draft (t/cm), while MTC is the moment needed to produce 1 cm of trim (t·m/cm); the two reflect vertical and longitudinal loading sensitivity respectively.
map.→ 打开船舶排水/载重吨计算工具: -> Open the ship displacement / deadweight calculator tool
map.新船或营运船舶配载核算时，按 LBP、型宽、各站吃水、方形系数与水密度算排水量、: When doing loading calculations for a new or operating vessel, use the LBP, the moulded breadth, the draft at each station, the block coefficient and the water density to compute the displacement, TPC, MTC and other hydrostatic parameters.
map.未给出时按经验 (2×Cb+1)/3 估算；已知则直接输入，系数影响水线面面积、: When not given, estimate it with the rule of thumb (2×Cb+1)/3; if it is known, enter it directly, since the coefficient affects the waterplane area, TPC and the stability.
map.水线面系数怎么取？: How is the waterplane coefficient chosen?
map.纵倾计算时，按首尾吃水差算纵倾方向与大小，并用 MTC 估算调整纵倾需移动的重量: When trimming, use the difference between the fore and aft drafts to get the direction and magnitude of the trim, and use MTC to estimate the weight that must be moved.
map.船舶排水/载重吨计算 使用指南: How to use the ship displacement / deadweight calculator
map.载重能力核算时，用排水量减去空船重量得 DWT，并与航次载货量核对。: When checking the deadweight, subtract the lightship weight from the displacement to get the DWT and reconcile it with the voyage cargo.
map.输入船舶垂线间长、型宽、首/中/尾吃水、方形系数与水密度，计算排水量、TPC、M: Enter the length between perpendiculars, the moulded breadth, the fore/mid/aft drafts, the block coefficient and the water density to compute the displacement, TPC, MTC, the trim and the deadweight
map.：LBP=100m、型宽=16m、首/中/尾吃水=5.0/5.2/5.4m、方形: : LBP=100m, moulded breadth=16m, fore/mid/aft drafts=5.0/5.2/5.4m, block coefficient 0.7, seawater density 1.025: waterplane coefficient Cw=(2×0.7+1)/3=0.8, mean draft 5.20m, displacement 5969.6t, waterplane area 1280m², TPC=13.12 t/cm, longitudinal metacentre height GML≈146.5m, MTC=87.47 t·m/cm; with a 0.4m stern trim and a 2000t lightship, DWT=3969.6t, and changing the trim by 1 cm requires moving about 87.5 t.
